nom: Jack Black Pure Clean Daily Facial Cleanser

avis.texte: This is my husband favorite cleanser, light and smells good! Keep the skin moisturized
Great product I have tried a couple of different ones and I received the travel set as a gift and really liked the results after using them

avis.titre: Excellent product as are all of Jack Black's
avis.texte: Absolutely recommend. Great cleanser without being overly harsh.

avis.titre: Very good cleanser!  Smells a bit like Ivory bar soap.
avis.texte: I've tried probably 20 or more facial cleansers over the years and this is in my top two (with Cetaphil unscented foaming cleanser). I'm 55 but still get a pimple every now and then, but this cleanser makes them very infrequent. The smell is not "manly," but it's not "feminine" either. It has a hint of the old Ivory bar soap, which I grew up using.
Excellent product I love how it feels and leaves my face clean I use it every morning and night
Jack Black is my go to product for hair, face and body. I've finally found a product that when I order I know I'm getting the highest quality. My wife even uses my daily face wash.
Product works well as a daily face cleanser. Mild scent. Leaves skin feeling nice.
I've been using this face wash for about a decade now. It's the best there is for man face. Nice, subtle fragrances, great clean.
Would highly recommend. Works exactly as promised and even better. Make sure to work up the lather which is easy!
This face wash made my skin so oily and break out… I don't recommend at all unless you have a very dry skin.
Great product for men quick easy to apply cleans face give s it a nice shine natural look women complete my skin never had that before .
Best products I've used, an I've tried several. Can't wait to try others, by the way I'm wondering if there's a human ( product SME) I can speak with? Please let me know. Thank You Larry D.
Anything jack black is amazing! But I do have oily skin and between this and the turbo bar I switch up but they are both amazing! I would highly recommend!
like all other JB products, I love this stuff. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way.
avis.texte: Every JB product I've ever used it top-tier, and this one in particular goes a loooong way, especially the pump bottle.
I recommend this product. After a long day at work, I look forward to coming home and washing my face, refreshing.
Pure clean does exactly what it says...takes away the oily feeling and leaves my face feeling refreshed.
Absolutely great product. Use it every day. Feels refreshing .

avis.titre: Love this but hate the pump!
avis.texte: I'm a woman with incredibly dry and flaky skin. I've tried many different face washes but in desperation I tried this after my husband bought it for himself. Now I won't use anything else! I love that it doesn't smell "manly" either. The pump is terrible though, it's really hard to push down and when it does it pushes out a FULL pump, forcing us to use way more face wash than we want and wasting it.
Needed something for daily use that wasn't an exfoliant. This seems to be a very good cleanser that doesn't dry skin out. The 16oz size seems like it will last for a while. One pump does the job.
Sent this item back. I am typically a big fan of JB products, but this one was not for me. Does not lather up at all, very runny. Did not leave any sort of clean feeling or freshness after use.
Great cleanser that leaves my face feeling clean, moisturized and without any buildup.

It's a 2 in 1 toner which is neat but other than that I have to say that it's nothing spectacular it's nice that it's Paraben, Fragrance, Sulfate, and Color free but it has Sage and Rosemary Essential Oils in which makes it in some ways worse but because you're washing it off quickly it shouldn't be that much of an issue although I was only able to use it once a day before I started flaking so it's why I gave it 3 stars it's too much for a product which uses essential oils and flakes my skin using it twice a day so it's not going to be my main cleanser sorry Jack Black that hurts to say
Good product. Leaves my skin feeling great after using it. My only complaint is about the pump on the large bottle — it's a little bit broken
Super awesome product!!! I use it in the mornings and evenings and it has given my skin a natural glow that I get good comments on regularly!! Thx so much for this!!
Great product it doesn't leave your skin dry or oily and it cleans it very well at the same time

This product is absolutely useless for me. I've used it for 3 days, twice a day. Within 20 minutes after use my face is as oily and dirty feeling as prior to using it. The product has little to no lather during use. It feels like you are trying to wash your face with hand lotion.
Easy to use and leaves your face feeling clean. I use it 2x daily.
It made me break out and didn't even leave my face feeling clean :(
Leaves face clean and feeling refreshed. Very little goes a long way. Get some, give it a try.
Bought twice for my son & he loves it. Jack Black products make great gifts for the men in your life.
Perfect face wash. Great scent, not overbearing. Clean finish.
Great daily face wash. Leaves my face feeling smooth and does not over dry. My wife uses it to remove eye make up. Lol

I should have written this review a long time ago, but here it is. My son was struggling with acne that covered most of his face. We went to see a dermatologist, and of course, they recommended and put him on a certain medication that starts with the letter A( that the filter will not allow me to type in this review. ) After 2 months of seeing what that medication was doing to my son (please research warnings/side effects before putting your child on this) I stopped the medication and searched for a new skin care line to try. I purchased this cleanser and the face moisturizer to go with it. I made sure my son used both products morning and night every single day. Literally, within a couple weeks, his skin was clearing up beautifully. After a month of use, he had a completely clear, beautiful complexion. He received complements regularly on how great his skin looked. It's been 2 years since I purchased our first Jack Black facial products and to this day, my son's skin is flawless. My husband and other son also use JB products. In my opinion, Jack black products are very cost effective, considering how long they last and how well they work. I'm not saying it works for everyone, just saying that if you are at the point of considering Acc-----, give this a try first!
Great stuff! It gets rid of any oiliness on my face but doesn't leave it dry. I use it twice a day.

avis.titre: Definitely I would buy it again and continue using it .. my
avis.texte: Ever since I got it my face has improved a lot .. will recommend this to everyone

Bought this for my husband to try. He hated it. I tried it just to see if it was really THAT bad. It's awful, will never buy again. It doesn't cleanse, it smells bad and makes you break out. Don't even bother with this one.
works really well!! after i use it my face feels super clean.
Great cleanser. Does not dry me out, and not oily either, it's just right.
I bought for my husband after I read so many good reviews. He used it one week, and then his face has pimples.
It does exactly what it sets out to do. Clean smell... clean face!

avis.titre: Jack Black Pure Clean Daily Facial Cleanser
avis.texte: I use Pure Clean Daily Facial Cleanser with Aloe & ge Leaf everyday and I am so impressed with it always use it forever!!! After using several other products, I have finally found the the face cleaner I have always wanted and my face is very happy about it. If you are looking for a product that will make your face feel clean and rejuvenated Jack Black Pure Clean Daily Facial Cleanser is for you!
I love this product so much. I'm ordering it for years to come.
This product sucks, my face still oily during the day. this product is doing nothing
This is a great daily cleanser. Not harsh on my skin and the scent is refreshing.

avis.titre: The best face cleanser by far.
avis.texte: "I will say that this is one of the BEST facial cleanser by far. I have been using it for at least five years. Ever since I've started using it the skin of my face has improved because the healthy ingredients it contains make my skin fresh and healthy. I will highly recommend this cleanser for those who have not used it as yet. I will definitely give it 5/5 stars."

I like the mild formulation of this wash. It's very light, we'll-fragranced, and doesn't dry out my face. Definitely need to make sure you work it into a light lather prior to application to really feel it working and I recommend leaving it on the skin for 15-30 seconds before rinsing.

I love all the Jack Black Products and specifically the smell of it. However the facial cleanser smells not good at all and I actually stopped using it since I just cannot deal with the smell every time I put it on my hand to wash my face. I was thinking maybe I just got a "bad batch".

I don't know if it sat on the shelf for a long time or this one is "defective" but when I opened it and squeeze it out of the tube, to my surprise it was very watery and runny. I can't even stand up the tube as the product would run and leak out of the top. How did this past QA?..
I have ordered this before, but this batch appears very runny. Formula change? Wont reorder Enjoyed this prior
This facial cleanser is BOMB! I have been a die-hard fan of another men's brand, until now. This cleanser is so great, cleaning my skin well without drying me out. Amazing!
My product showed up very runny from previous times. Very watery, my others were more like a pliable paste. This one will literally run out of the tube. What happened? Thank you.
I've bought this product at least four times. I will continue to buy it. It cleans my skin very well. It gets rid of all facial oil on the service. Making your skin feel nice and clean.
Clean, no overzealous scent, in fact, none at all when you're finished. Only a small drop needed to lather your entire face. Cleans oil and dirt for easier, closer shave.
An absolute staple in my husband's skin care regimen. Effective, refreshing, and non-drying.
Just right for frequently face cleaning with just enough 'grit' to lightly exfoliate. I rotate this with the regular JB Facial Cleanser.
Use it twice a wk but with the summer months been using it every other day. Doesn't leave my face feeling dried out like other face washes do.
This face wash is great! Super refreshing and nourishing at the same time. Would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Not good for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: Received a sample of this in a package from Jack Black when I bought their terrific hand lotion. Liked the sample and bought the three tube package. After a couple of days regular use, though, the product left my face tomato-red. Put it aside for a couple of weeks and tried again, with the same result. Perhaps it's good for some, but not for me.
Excellent products, I also use the turbo body wash and it is a great product as well.

I've been using this for over a year now. It's my go to daily cleanser. Cleans well without excessive drying. I have oily/dry sensitive skin with large pores. I've tried many other popular brands. Face Buff and Daily Cleanser are my Jack Black Staples.
Great product and great quality, your face feels fresh and young all over again. A must!
I am a VERY loyal Jack Black customer/fan. I use 5 or 6 of their men's products religiously and would recommend their brand to any male concerned about their skin.
Disappointed by this product given all the good reviews. It dried my face up more than any cleanser I've tried. The moisturizer couldn't even help.

Product basically burned my face. Used as directed, don't have particularly sensitive skin. Felt and looked like a sunburn. Great reviews and at the price point I assumed a good purchase. Perhaps works for others but a waste of money for me.
Love how gently it is and still leaves my face feeling clean.
I thought I couldn't go wrong with the high ratings but this burned my skin terribly and broke me out. I'm still healing from whatever is in this.
Leaves your face nice and clean without trashing or drying out your skin.
Great stuff! I use this for my face, and Turbo Wash for my body EVERYDAY. I've never felt better. My face feels great, and my body loves the Turbo Wash. Customer for life! You get what you pay for.
A little goes a long way with this product. I alternate two straight nights with the Face Buff wash.

avis.titre: A Must Have For Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: In the last few years, my face has become increasingly sensitive, becoming more red and irritated. Cleansers that I have used for years had suddenly stopped working on my face. I had tried different products, from other brands like to no avail, so I decided to give this wash a try, since it already had a mild toner in it. I have been a long time fan of Jack Black products already, and we sell it where I worked, so I gave it a try and fell in love. It cleans well, reduces redness, and does not dry my skin well. I follow it with the Double Duty face moisturizer. My only issue is that it does not seem to penetrate my beard as much as I'd like, so I'll be giving the beard wash a try soon, but otherwise, it's a nose perfect product.
I like the results of the daily facial cleanser! My face feels clean and refreshed. Great product!

avis.titre: Its Good, But Not as Good as Deep Dive
avis.texte: I think this is a good product for gentle cleaning. My girlfriend uses it all the time and loves it. For me, I feel that Deep Dive offers a better clean and keeps the oil at bay longer. I will continue to use that.

I have been using this face cleanser for about 8 months and have noticed that I have less redness. I am prone to redness in the T area of the face due to excessive sweating at the gym. I use this morning and night and works great. A little goes a long way, so I use it sparingly.

There was no major wow factor for this cleanser. It didn't make me "feel" super clean, it didn't have a "true" scent, and although with my other facial cleansers I am good at keeping it out of my eyes, two days in a row I got a major sting and red eye for the day. The pain in my eye actually lasted for a duration of time that I thought a flushing would get out, but it didn't. I am now going to gift it to someone else.
Really like to use this cleanser after shaving. It has a pleasant feel and the mild astringent effect comes in handy.

This cleanser is amazing. SO much so that I can feel a difference in anything else I happen to put on my face, especially how dry other products make my face. This cleanser makes my face clean and smooth and certainly not dry
The title says it all. Works well for pre-shave as well as before going to bed. A little bit goes along way. I highly recommend this product.

I suffer from acne-prone skin, along with an oily forehead, and this was not a strong cleanser for me. I noticed some breakouts about a week after I started using this, and my face didn't feel as fresh as when I use other cleansers. Very disappointed, because I was looking forward to adding this in to my daily routine.

avis.titre: Best Product for Men on the market!
avis.texte: I am a licensed skin care professional and absolutely love ALL products by Jack Black. I always recommend to clients and of course my hunny has every step of skin care by Jack Black to keep his skin smooth and hydrated!

I bought a 16 oz size of this product and really don't like it all after using it for a week. To me the product has a smell and texture that doesn't seem to be "Pure Clean". I love the Jack Black "All-0ver Wash" but this Facial Cleanser was a big disappointment.
Smells nice. Leaves skin feeling clean workout drying or feeling greasy.

This product clenses the skin very well. I have bought it several times. It has a very mild sent. So there basically is no smell after using it. But there is one thing about the tube. If you don't lay it on the side. It goes down to the cap.
Nice facial cleanser. Cleans well and firms up face after a long day. Great refreshner!
I like how well this strips everything from my face and especially how well it removes the oil from inside my ears. This is now my go to facial cleanser. I would recommend this to anyone.

avis.titre: Great for the dry climate in the mountains
avis.texte: Pleasantly surprised with the facial cleaner. Leaves a nice feeling on your skin and in a dry climate it makes a difference. You don't need to much to get the full effects. Very pleased with the purchase.
Nothing bad to say about this product. Great smell, fast acting, feels smooth after use. No complaints here. I would reccomend and I plan on future purchase of this product.

avis.titre: Best Daily Face Wash for Men on the Market
avis.texte: I have been using this product for several years. It feels good on your face when you are washing it and it is not heavy.

avis.titre: Pure Clean Daily Facial Cleanser Works Great
avis.texte: Excellent daily cleanser with a very pleasant fragrance. It's not too harsh and doesn't leave skin feeling dry or taut. I'd recommend it.

I was able to turn my husband onto skincare with this product. He is old fashioned and didn't care how he cared for the skin on his face meaning he just used regular body soda or shampoo to wash his face until I got him a gift set at Christmas with this product in it and now it is all he will use to wash his face.
Nice to use everyday keeps my skin looking vibrant and limiting the shiness caused by oil.
I loved this product immediately. It has a refreshing and clean feeling and manly smell.
I have used lots of different types of face wash and this one has worked the best for me. Also smells good which is a huge plus.
I love the way it smells and how my face feels after I use it. There has been a noticeable difference in the condition of my skin, especially after shaving!
My hubby loves this cleanser and I've used it a few times myself. Once in a while I try something for him a bit less pricey but he always wants to go back to Jack Black

avis.titre: Great buy for a daily face wash
avis.texte: Will buy it again but definitely need an exfoliating wash to go with this as well as I work outside and dirt builds up on my face
Excellent! Love the subtle scent, doesn't dry your skin after use.
This face wash is just ok. I have used better. Don't think I will buy it again.

I typically have never been a big fan of personal care products as they have tended to have a less than beneficial impact on my skin. However, this is a product that I have noticed has provided nice benefits in that my skin not only feels clean afterwards but refreshed as well.
This cleanser lathers well, leaves skin feeling great, and has a really nice gentle scent. Top of the line. Well worth it.

avis.titre: JACK BLACK IS THE BEST  TRY AND YOU WILL LOVE
avis.texte: i am an 82 years man and not believe im that old so is tru than i have been using others products for years but believe me no one is like Jack Black is an orgasmon to use this products so exquisite to the feeling with the skin love Jack Black and i have to order other things JACK BLACK thanks very much muchas gracias and keep doing it better all i can tell you gays try and u will like jack love to you and yours products

The pads work well, leaves skin very clean with a nice tone. Only issue I have is if you don't use the pads regularly they will dry out and are worthless. Not sure what can be done, maybe include a small amount of the fluid to be added once they start to dry out, Thanks

Great facial cleanser with no added colors, which is actually hard to find. Doesn't leave my face feeling dry and tight. Only negative I have is I'd rather have the flip top tube in the larger size rather than the pump with the stiff bottle. Its easier to get more of the product out in the flip top tube and the pumps are not recyclable in my area.
My husband's favorite facial soap! Paired with the shave gel and he's the best smelling and happiest guy around. Super great products.
Great daily facial cleanser. Doesn't leave my face feeling dried out afterward and no breakouts. Will purchase again.
I buy this for my son's. Gentle facial wash. Love that is is sulfate and paraben free. Gentle on psoriasis.
Excellent cleanser. Skin doesn't feel dry and tight and it has a subtle, refreshing smell. I won't use anything else.
I've tried a lot of men's facial products and this is the cleanser that works best for me. It handles my oily forehead without drying out my cheeks.
Can't live without it ! Best I've ever used....as well as other JB products. Highly Recommend!
I really enjoy this product. My face really feels clean after using it, what more can you ask for in a face cleaners. I would highly recommend this product.
Very good product. Smells great as well love the natural ingredients!

I have been using Pure Clean for years and it has never failed me. I actually tried using a store bought face wash to see how it compared to see if I could save some money and wow was I surprised that the results weren't even close. Pure Clean keeps my face clean without over-drying but strips all the oils and grime after a long day leaving my face refreshed. JB, I commend you on your quality to these fine products you offer.
I have used this product for several years. Love the way my skin feels afterwards.

This cleans my face thoroughly, doesn't irritate my skin or eyes and while it smells pleasant enough it doesn't really leave any scent behind. And like many JB products, a little goes a long way. I use it in conjunction with Turbo Wash which I find a but too harsh for the face.
Out of every product I've bought, this really clears my skin. Everything else doesn't even compare to this.
